decided.point: Don't take it up as a new practice, because the repo already works this way; at most a small tweak to the existing fragments (for example a skip rule for trivial changes, or reading fragments in review).
decided.detail: Either 'no' or a minor 'adapt' is right.

why.point: Lanternhall already has the idea: every pull request that changes src/ or migrations/ adds a typed news fragment in changes/, bin/check enforces it, and bin/release compiles the fragments into CHANGELOG.md.
why.detail: Docs-only changes are already exempt, as in the post.

next.point: No new work beyond, at most, a small tweak to the existing fragment practice.
next.detail: It would be reopened if fragments stopped being useful, for example notes turning into box-ticking.
